english:
Perfect! Taiki
watched me! My
friendship went
way up!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Oh, I missed
it.
That's a shame.
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Whoa! A ring of
fire! Looks
fun!
Let me try!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Yahoo!
Thrilling
and exciting!
My
EXP went up,
too!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Yow! It's hot!
No way I can do
this! My tail's
on fire!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Fire Road looks
hot... You want
me
to cross that?
Who
thought this
up?
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Body and spirit
on fire! My EXP
went up!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
No way! Whoever
made this
should
try it first!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Fireworks? Huh.
That actually
sounds fun!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Wow, beautiful!
My EXP went up,
too! What a
show!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Those fireworks
never lit or
launched...
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Whoa, a giant
ball! Should I
stand on it?
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
This raised my
EXP? Too easy!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
It looks easy,
but it's pretty
tough...
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
You want me to
walk that rope?
Sounds fun!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
That was easier
than I thought!
I had fun and
gained EXP!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
Scary, painful,
and hard! I
fell
off, too. The
worst!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
A circus tent!?
What am I meant
to do in there?
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
My circus act
raised my EXP!
The details are
a trade secret!
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
All that
spinning
and bending? No
way! How would
it
even help a
Digimon?
blocks.review_note: DigiFarm event report; fixed 15-column dialogue cells.

english:
I've gotten a
little
stronger!
I'll protect
Sky
Fort, Patamon,
and everyone...
if I can.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Well said,
Spadamon.
You're
no coward.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.
HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
I see. With
friends beside
you, you've
found
your courage.
Taiki, train
Spadamon well.
We Digimon who
live here will
help however we
can.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Look at those
busybodies.
They
planned to help
you from the
start.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Ask Gatomon
over
there about
communications.

Summon Ticket,

english:
The nearest
Capacitor Tower
is at Knuckle
Coast East. Try
there next.
We're
all counting on
you.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
I've always run
away... It
feels
nice to have
people count on
me. H-hey!
Don't
make me say
that!
I'm going back
in the Xros
Loader!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Taiki! Are you
hearing
everyone's
requests? Check
the
Quest Monitor!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Taiki! Are you
hearing
everyone's
requests? Check
the
Quest Monitor!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Hey... Everyone
around here
expects
a lot from us!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
They think
we're
going to save
the
world. Maybe we
should do it!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
We're going to
a
tower... What
was
it called? Oh,
a
Capacitor
Tower!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Activate as
many
of the six
towers
on the Energy
Continent as
you
can. Each one
sends power
back
to Sky Fort.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
We still don't
know where
Chibickmon
is.
If he were
nearby,
he'd hear me
call.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Chibickmon is
back!
Everyone's
relieved, me
too.
Thanks,
brother!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
I don't get
Minervamon. She
says she took
Chibickmon
because he's
cute.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Hey, brother!
You heard
Sparrowmon call
for help? Then
we'll find him
soon enough!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
I heard
Sparrowmon
is stuck in the
ruins. How did
that happen?
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Sparrowmon came
back safe, but
he says he
can't
remember a
thing.
What a mess...
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Not sure what
to
do next,
brother?
We'll work it
out.
Don't worry!
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
That's a fine
party you have.
Ask me anytime
if
you'd like me
to
join you.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
That's a fine
party you have.
Ask me anytime
if
you'd like me
to
join you.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
What lovely
companions! If
you'd like me
to
join you, just
ask. No rush.
blocks.review_note: HQ or nearby NPC dialogue; fixed 15-column story cells.

english:
Nice party! Let
me join you!
Ask
and I'll jump
right in!
